items.title: IndustryLLM: Failure-Driven LLM Training for Industrial Procurement
items.title_zh: IndustryLLM：面向工业采购的失败驱动 LLM 训练
items.summary: Alibaba presents IndustryLLM, an open-weight 35B-parameter industrial model built on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base and trained with a failure-driven continued-pretraining and supervised fine-tuning recipe on a roughly 100B-token corpus. Offline procurement-query structuring improves by 2.97 exact-match points, while production A/B tests report 4.25% higher GMV, 8.3% more satisfied inquiries and latency falling from 6-7 s to 1.5 s.

items.title: COUNTERMEM: World-Model Verified Counter-Factual Memory for Language Agents
items.title_zh: COUNTERMEM：面向语言智能体的世界模型验证反事实记忆
items.summary: COUNTERMEM is a reinforcement-learning framework that builds verified counterfactual memory by testing local alternative actions against executable world models such as tests, proof checkers and solvers after a failure. With gpt-oss-120b it improves ReAct and Reflexion on all 12 benchmarks across six domains, averaging a 12.6-point gain while cutting task-run tokens by 7.7-42.0% in a four-domain comparison.

items.title: EngramRAG: Dynamic Usage-Weighted Topology and Synaptic Consolidation for Multi-Hop Agentic Memory
items.title_zh: EngramRAG：面向多跳智能体记忆的动态使用加权拓扑与突触巩固
items.summary: EngramRAG couples a low-latency waking retrieval reflex with asynchronous dreaming-state consolidation, adding usage-modulated PageRank, topology-aware decay, a SUPERSEDES DAG filter and hybrid dense, BM25 and graph retrieval. On all 1,982 LoCoMo QA pairs it reports +38.9% relative Recall@5 and +43.1% MRR over dense-vector RAG, and cuts split-brain hallucinations from 70.0% to 0.0% in mutation tests.

items.title: Metro-WM: Long-Horizon Latent Planning with Realisable Sub-Goals
items.title_zh: Metro-WM：以可实现的子目标进行长程潜空间规划
items.summary: Metro-WM replaces unconstrained latent sub-goal prediction with retrieval of genuine observed frames from a graph built from offline expert demonstrations, so a hierarchical planner only issues physically realisable sub-goals. It reports long-horizon success gains of up to 37.33 points over the strongest hierarchical baseline while being up to 10.9x faster and requiring 13-56x less offline compute.

items.title: TemporalGraphLLM: Temporal Graph Neural Networks with Large Language Models for Dynamic Text-Attributed Graphs
items.title_zh: TemporalGraphLLM：面向动态文本属性图的大语言模型与时序图神经网络
items.summary: TemporalGraphLLM integrates any temporal graph neural network with an LLM by fine-tuning the model with graph-time-aware instructions and injecting graph embeddings in place of dedicated added tokens. The authors report state-of-the-art results on edge classification, link prediction and edge-based text generation across real-world dynamic graph datasets.

items.title: EmailBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Enterprise Email and Productivity Tasks
items.title_zh: EmailBench：评估 LLM 智能体企业邮件与生产力任务的基准
items.summary: EmailBench contains 206 email and productivity scenarios across 16 task categories, pairing a typed email API with a deterministic synthetic Enron-inspired corpus and a hybrid protocol of 258 static assertions and 211 LLM rubrics. The best of eight LM configurations passes only 33.5% of scenarios even though 99.7% of its tool calls complete without an observed API failure.

items.title: GameBoyWorlds: A Testbed for Self-Improvement in Embodied Video Games
items.title_zh: GameBoyWorlds：具身电子游戏自我改进的测试平台
items.summary: GameBoyWorlds is a testbed for agentic self-improvement in video games, with an Execution split of 500 tasks across five game series and a Playthrough split requiring end-to-end completion of two fan-made Pokémon games. Out-of-the-box frontier models complete fewer than 50% of execution tasks, and a pipeline with multimodal memory and hierarchical subgoals fails to reach the first major milestone in either playthrough.

items.title: Toward Interactive Understanding of Code APIs
items.title_zh: 迈向代码 API 的交互式理解
items.summary: The paper introduces PAU, a benchmark that gives models only black-box API-level access to Python snippets so they must probe the code and infer its behaviour, framing this as unsupervised tool understanding. Claude-4-Opus fails to understand over 45% of the test set, and Asymmetric Actor Critic post-training lets an AAC-tuned Qwen3-8B match GPT-5-mini.
